documentationApplicability.existingProjectPrerequisite: Account-level network injection must already be in place. The existing-account identity module only references the account; it does not update networkInjections. add-existing-project alone is therefore not a proven fix for the observed account.
documentationApplicability.sampleQualification: The sample README still describes a setup without tools behind VNet. Its reuse modules are configuration evidence, not proof that this particular Responses/managed Search MCP path works.
documentationApplicability.mcpGuide: Documents private MCP with private networking and project-managed-identity connections. Custom MCP-on-ACA subnet guidance must not automatically be imposed on Search's managed knowledge-base endpoint.
documentationApplicability.foundryIqTutorialQualification: The current tutorial uses 2026-08-01-preview, while MACAE's KB MCP URL uses 2025-11-01-preview. Search-to-Blob/Foundry outbound guidance is not the same direction as Foundry-to-Search. Its ingestion-time embedding trusted-service bypass is not authorized here.
